title: Scheduled Trigger Node
description: Workflow entry point triggered on a time-based schedule using cron expressions or simple intervals.

schedule_type.description: Type of schedule: 'interval' for ISO 8601 repeating intervals or 'cron' for cron expressions.

interval.description: ISO 8601 repeating interval string (e.g., 'R/2024-01-01T10:00:00Z/P1D'). Required when schedule_type is 'interval'.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (e.g., '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9am). Required when schedule_type is 'cron'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York'). Defaults to UTC if not specified.

missed_schedule_policy.description: How to handle overlapping schedule executions. Defaults to 'skip'.

resultSchema.description: Trigger result contains the schedule metadata passed through as output.

schedule_type.description: The schedule type that triggered this execution
